theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have hi : (P : Set (Set S)).Intersecting := by
    simpa only [Set.Intersecting, Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty, Finset.mem_coe] using hPP
  have hc : 2 * P.card = Fintype.card (Set S) := hi.is_max_iff_card_eq.mp (by
    intro Q hQ hPQ
    apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
    intro A hA
    by_contra h
    exact hPS ⟨A, h, fun U hU he =>
      hQ hA (hPQ hU) (Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr he)⟩)
  rw [Fintype.card_set] at hc
  have hp := Fintype.card_pos (α := S)
  have he : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by omega
  have hh : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_succ, he]
  omega

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [Ne, ← Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, ← Fintype.card_set]
  apply (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP).mp
  intro Q hQ hPQ
  apply Finset.Subset.antisymm hPQ
  intro A hA
  by_contra h
  exact hPS ⟨A, h, fun U hU => hQ hA (hPQ hU)⟩

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not.symm] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by

  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not.symm] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not.symm] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not.symm] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  simp only [Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.not.symm] at hPP hPS
  apply Nat.mul_left_cancel Nat.two_pos
  rw [mul_pow_sub_one Fintype.card_ne_zero, Fintype.card_set.symm,
    ← Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq hPP]
  grind [Set.Intersecting]

  grind [Set.Intersecting]

(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)

    intro A hA
    by_contra h

      ext x
      simp
      
    have h₃ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A hA Aᶜ h
    rw [h₂] at h₃
    contradiction
  
  classical
  
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)) \ P
  
  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    
    have h₂ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∈ Q := by grind
    have h₃ : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ Q → Aᶜ ∈ P := by grind
    
    
    
    
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp_all

      simp only [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]

  have h₄ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    
    have h₆ : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
    omega
  
  
  have h₈ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have h₉ : Fintype.card S - 1 + 1 = Fintype.card S := by
      
      omega
    calc
      2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 ^ 1 := by exact rfl
